JobSummary.description: One job: its run, node, kind and state.

error_code.description: The catalog code it failed with; empty unless it failed.

kind.description: Its job kind, such as train.

run_id.description: The run it belongs to; empty for a job without a run.

state.description: Its job state, such as running.

JobSummary.title: JobSummary

NodeSummary.description: One node: how the daemon reaches it, its state and its last heartbeat.

address.description: user@host for an SSH node; empty for the embedded one.

capabilities.description: The capability flags of its handshake.

last_heartbeat_unix_ms.description: When its last heartbeat arrived; 0 or absent before the first.

protocol_version.description: The node protocol version it speaks.

state.description: Its connection state, such as connected.

transport.description: local for the embedded node, ssh for a paired one.

NodeSummary.title: NodeSummary

result.description: One node in detail: its state, last telemetry and unfinished jobs.

jobs.description: The jobs on the node that haven't finished.

telemetry.description: Its last heartbeat's telemetry; absent before the first heartbeat. Protobuf JSON of rastai.common.v1.NodeTelemetry.

result.title: NodeStatusResult
